verdict.rationale: Jan runs local GGUF models via llama.cpp, so runtime-upgrade compatibility with downloaded quantized files is a fair question for this product. The evidence pack has no compatibility policy, changelog note, or migration guidance about whether engine upgrades break existing GGUF files. The /v1 API prefix covers API paths, not model-file compatibility, so it does not count here.

support.subject: As a developer, I know whether upgrading the runtime can break compatibility with previously downloaded quantized model files
